description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams, used to hold search filter parameters for employee anniversary queries within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as thisYear, nextDate, dateDiffMin, and dateDiffMax, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee anniversaries, including year, upcoming date, and date difference ranges.

methods.name: getThisYear
methods.description: Retrieves the year as a string used in search filters.

methods.name: setThisYear
methods.description: Sets the year as a string used in search filters.

methods.name: getNextDate
methods.description: Retrieves the next upcoming date for anniversary calculations.

methods.name: setNextDate
methods.description: Sets the next upcoming date for anniversary calculations.

methods.name: getDateDiffMin
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum date difference value used for filtering.

methods.name: setDateDiffMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum date difference value used for filtering.

methods.name: getDateDiffMax
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum date difference value used for filtering.

methods.name: setDateDiffMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum date difference value used for filtering.
